style.backgroundSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF for packshots, matte kraft corrugated surface #C8A277 for use and spec screens, solid signal-blue #1B87C9 field for infographic and close frames
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons plus flat solid curved arrows in #232323 and #1B87C9, blank circular callout discs, no 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio key front-left with fill card, daylight use scenes graded to 5500K from the left, soft contact shadows only, controlled plastic sheen without harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold primary color-block packing-supply commerce system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, signal blue #1B87C9, hi-chroma yellow #F5C400 and kraft brown #C8A277; neutral temperature with daylight scenes at 5500K; charcoal ink #232323 for all type; square-cornered solid color-block copy panels, never rounded pills; flat single-color header bands and blank circular callout discs with flat curved arrows; thin single-weight line icons only; plain kraft corrugated cartons and concrete surfaces as the only props; stable centred product scale with the roll core facing camera; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no gradient or patterned backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no brand marks or decorative fabric patterns.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or white balance between panels
no brand marks, wordmarks or decorative fabric patterns
no rounded-corner badges or glossy 3D icons
style.presentationRules: packshot unit upright and centred with its circular core facing camera, one consistent slight 3/4 hand-tool angle across the set, stable product scale, tape strip always laid along a carton seam
style.surfaceSystem: plain kraft corrugated cartons #C8A277, grey concrete loading floor #B8B2AA, neutral matte board #EFEAE3
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, heavy uppercase display lines in charcoal ink #232323 or #FFFFFF, square-corner color blocks instead of rounded pills, copy always sits in solid panels
